_about: 2-Butanone (1) + n-Heptane (2): isothermal total pressures at 303.2 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: B. Liebergesell, T. Brands, H.-J. Kobeta, A. Bardow, Quaternary isothermal vapor-liquid equilibrium of the model biofuel 2-butanone + n-heptane + tetrahydrofuran + cyclohexane using Raman spectroscopic characterization, Fluid Phase Equilib. 472 (2018) 107-116
